idea-plugin.name: PHP Magic Method Navigation
idea-plugin.description:
Navigate PHP's invisible magic-method calls.

PHP invokes some methods implicitly: a (string) cast or an echo secretly calls __toString(); $callable(...) secretly calls __invoke(); $obj->prop / $obj->method() fall through to __get()/__set()/__call() when the member isn't really declared. None of these mention the method by name, so the IDE offers no jump to the code that actually runs. This plugin adds it.

  • A gutter icon at every implicit site — a (string) cast, an echo/print, string interpolation ("$obj"), concatenation ("x" . $obj), dynamic invokes ($callable(...)), and member access that resolves to no real member: $obj->prop → __get(), $obj->prop = … → __set(), $obj->m(...) → __call(), Foo::m(...) → __callStatic(). Union types open a multi-target popup.
  • Go to Declaration (Ctrl+Click / Ctrl+B) on the operand also offers the magic method, alongside the normal jump.
  • Reverse Find Usages: running Find Usages on a magic method (e.g. __toString) also lists the implicit sites that trigger it.
  • Only marks member access when the magic method genuinely fires — a reference that resolves to a real declared property/const/method is left alone. Correctly handles the \Stringable interface, nullable/union types (only members that actually declare the method are offered), and de-duplicates so nested and multi-argument sites never double-mark.

Configurable under Settings | Tools | PHP Magic Nav.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
• 0.2.0 — Member-access magic: gutter markers + Go to Declaration for __get()/__set() on undeclared $obj->prop read/write, and __call()/__callStatic() on undeclared $obj->m(...)/Foo::m(...) calls — only when the member does not resolve to a real declaration. Added reverse Find Usages: Find Usages on a magic method lists its implicit invocation sites. Per-method settings toggles for all six magic methods plus reverse Find Usages.
  • 0.1.0 — First release. Forward navigation to __toString() from casts, echo/print, interpolation and concatenation; navigation to __invoke() from dynamic $callable(...) calls; gutter markers + Go to Declaration; multi-target unions; settings toggles.
